Get Generalised Geometries for Thematic Maps (ThemaKart)

Source: R/geo-themakart.R
geoThemakart.Rd

Reads a layer of the BFS map geometry sets for small-scale thematic maps ("Kartengeometrien ThemaKart"). These generalised geometries are the official basis for statistical maps of Switzerland: small, fast to draw and available for many spatial units besides the institutional ones.

Usage

geoThemakart(
  unit = "gemeinde",
  date = NULL,
  area = c("total", "vegetation"),
  output = c("polygon", "point"),
  setYear = NULL,
  crs = 2056,
  cache = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

unit

spatial unit: one of "gemeinde", "bezirk", "kanton", "schweiz", "grossregion", "ms-region", "sprachgebiet", "agglomeration", "metropolitanraum", "tourismusregion", "arbeitsmarktregion", "arbeitsmarktgrossregion", or a four-letter ThemaKart code such as "deur".

date

stand of the boundaries, a Date or a string "YYYY-MM-DD". The default NULL uses the most recent stand in the set.

area

"total" for the total area or "vegetation" for the vegetation area, i.e. the inhabitable area without lakes and high mountains.

output

"polygon" for the areas or "point" for the official label points of the units.

setYear

year of the ThemaKart set; see Details.

crs

target CRS. The default harmonises all layers to LV95 (EPSG:2056), since not all layers of a set share one CRS.

cache

logical; if TRUE, results are read from and written to the local cache (see cacheList()).

refresh

logical; if TRUE, the source is queried again even if a cached copy exists.

Value

An sf object with stand_d, an id and a name column (gem_id/gem_x, bezirk_id/bezirk_x, kanton_id/kanton_x plus kanton_c, otherwise region_id/region_x) and the geometry. The attribute "themakart" records set, unit and stand, so that plotMap() can find the matching vegetation area and label points.

Details

A set is downloaded once (about 12 MB) as zip archive into the cache and read from the archive in place, without unpacking. refresh = TRUE downloads it anew and replaces the cached archive only after the new one has been verified; on failure the cached set is kept with a warning. A set holds the geometries of its own stand (and possibly a few older ones). Without setYear, the sets are searched for the most recent stand on or before date: first the set of the year of date, then the newer sets, then the older ones; each set searched is downloaded once. Without date the most recent set is used. The stand found is returned in stand_d and reported by a message if it differs from date. To use an already unpacked set, e.g. from a former bfsMaps installation, set options(helvetia.themakartDir = <path>) and optionally options(helvetia.themakartSet = <year>).

Maps published with these geometries must carry the source note "Kartengrundlage: (c) BFS, ThemaKart"; see stampBfs().

See also

geoGemeinde(), plotMap(), geoGewaesser().

Other swiss.geometry: geo-boundaries, geoGewaesser(), themakartSets()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
kt <- geoThemakart("kanton")
plot(sf::st_geometry(kt))
} # }
